_about: Optional corrections for the Fragrance family and Occasion filters. By default they are worked out from each perfume's listed notes. To fix one, add a line like:  "perfume-id": { "families": ["woody", "spicy"], "occasions": ["date", "winter"] }.  Families: woody, amber, citrus, floral, fruity, gourmand, fresh, aromatic, spicy, oud.  Occasions: office, date, party, summer, winter.
